Most of the smart lights in your home are likely smaller bulbs and outlet adapters, but the market is maturing, and we're now starting to see full lighting lines that integrate natively into Apple Home via Matter. SwitchBot recently launched its new SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light, which brings extremely bright illumination and native Matter support to your ceiling fixtures.

HomeKit Weekly is a series focused on smart home accessories, automation tips, and news related to Apple's smart home framework.

Native Matter and Apple Home Integration

The most notable aspect of this new ceiling light is that it supports Matter right out of the box, with no need for a SwitchBot Hub. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod is online, it can connect directly to your existing ecosystem via a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Hardware Size and Brightness

SwitchBot offers two sizes to suit different needs. The 12-inch model is designed for hallways and bathrooms, with a brightness of 2000 lumens. The larger 15-inch model is better suited for living rooms and bedrooms, delivering up to 3200 lumens. The SwitchBot features built-in stepless dimming from 100% to 0%.

Typical smart bulbs usually only let you pick one color at a time, but this light uses RGBIC technology with independent chips, allowing it to display multiple colors simultaneously on the ceiling for dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer traditional lighting, the fixture also includes separate warm white and cool white LEDs, with adjustable color temperature ranging from 2700K to 6500K. It also has a power-off memory feature, meaning that if there's a brief power interruption, the light will retain your original brightness and color settings. SwitchBot RGBICWW Final Thoughts

Using a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection means adding another permanently connected device to your router on an older frequency band. If Thread radio capability could be added, I think it would achieve near-instantaneous response within a mesh network. Getting a wired-installed, natively Matter-supported light for under $50 is a great deal for anyone looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling lighting.

You can purchase this new SwitchBot RGBICWW on Amazon.
